actor.query: SELECT tenant_id,user_id,public_id,person_public_id,identity_plane,status,version,access_revision FROM public.com_users WHERE tenant_id=:verifiedTenant AND user_id=:verifiedActingUserId
actor.personBinding: Auth person_public_id belongs to the ACTOR only; never copied to NONSELF target. Acting userId internal BIGINT never becomes public UUID.
actor.currentRecheck: After target/source refetch and immediately before command CAS: actor row/access revision, ACTIVE/TENANT, permission/SoD/population/field/step-up decision/current proof expiry. Missing adapter => no source/owner command calls.
actor.purposeProfile: Current fixed SELF_PROFILE_READ/HRIS_HRM is NOT any of the proposed six acting purposes. Existing SELF consumer tests prove SELF only.

target.actualReader: NOT_PRESENT: NativeSelfContextQueryReaderV1 accepts SELF guard-issued PeopleLookup only.
target.selector: PERSON: explicit authorized person UUID + expected person version. EMPLOYMENT: worker/relationship/assignment3UUID; derive person through same tenant internal parents; compare native People4 versions. No link ID, target principal or fabricated Auth binding.
target.personQuery: SELECT person_id,tenant_id,public_id,version,lifecycle_state FROM public.ppl_persons WHERE tenant_id=:verifiedTenant AND public_id=:populationAuthorizedPersonUUID
target.employmentQuery: SELECT p.public_id,p.version,w.public_id,w.version,r.public_id,r.version,r.start_date,r.end_date,e.public_id,a.public_id,a.version,a.effective_start_date,a.effective_end_date,a.effective_sequence,l.time_zone FROM public.ppl_workers w JOIN public.ppl_persons p ON p.tenant_id=w.tenant_id AND p.person_id=w.person_id JOIN public.ppl_work_relationships r ON r.tenant_id=w.tenant_id AND r.worker_id=w.worker_id JOIN public.ppl_assignments a ON a.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND a.work_relationship_id=r.work_relationship_id JOIN public.ppl_legal_employers e ON e.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND e.legal_employer_id=r.legal_employer_id JOIN public.ppl_locations l ON l.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND l.location_id=a.location_id WHERE w.tenant_id=:verifiedTenant AND w.public_id=:workerUUID AND r.public_id=:relationshipUUID AND a.public_id=:assignmentUUID AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.ppl_assignments c WHERE c.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND c.assignment_key=a.assignment_key AND c.effective_start_date=a.effective_start_date AND c.effective_sequence>a.effective_sequence)
target.guard: Owner target PEP before disclosure, current owner policy refetch and complete version/tenant/parent/field/purpose/SoD compare before write. Exactly one native tuple; higher same-start sequence invalidates requested older tuple; different-start overlap/current incomplete owner set fails. Inclusive DATE in explicit assignment location time_zone and exact asOf <= current owner clock; no UTC/default zone.
target.personOnly: No worker/employment/location/Auth target row required. MERGED is not supported by current raw enum; owner merge successor policy OPEN, no ACTIVE coercion.
target.legalEmployer: Actual forward common People V49 public_id, never BIGINT/key→UUID. Observed source is not published DTO/proof.
target.creation: Before native person exists, CreationPopulation authorizes source/workspace mutation, NOT a fake person/version0. People INSERT RETURNING native public_id/version/person_id becomes actual subject after successful creation.

ATS_CASE.requiredOwner: People RecruitingATS capability, optional installed only
ATS_CASE.query: planned public.ppl_rec_candidate_cases c JOIN public.ppl_rec_requisitions r ON r.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND r.requisition_id=c.requisition_id WHERE c.tenant_id=:tenant AND c.public_id=:candidateUUID
ATS_CASE.compare: Exact case version/requisition/token/source/consent, usable case stage and consent current owner decision. Token digest never person identity; Privacy evidence refetch binds real vault identity and permission.
ATS_CASE.disabled: Fail ATS_DISABLED before ATS provider lookup; zero calls. Generic HR_NATIVE/IMPORT paths never resolve this provider.

IMPORT.requiredOwner: People native staged import manifest (NEW planned) with accepted normalized item; optional connector only for OPTIONAL_CONNECTOR mode
IMPORT.query: planned public.ppl_native_admission_import_batches b JOIN public.ppl_native_admission_import_items i ON i.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND i.batch_id=b.batch_id WHERE b.tenant_id=:tenant AND b.public_id=:batchUUID AND i.public_id=:itemUUID
IMPORT.compare: Accepted batch/item exact versions, tenant, mapping schema/version/digest, sourceRecordKey and normalized facts/person evidence. NATIVE_STAGED makes zero external connector calls; OPTIONAL_CONNECTOR missing/disabled blocks before calls.
IMPORT.noNativeSourceUuid: Existing int_source_systems has source_key/BIGINT and no public_id. Do not populate ppl_persons.source_system_id with opaque SYS UUID; native Person CREATE uses nullable source_system_id/external_id=NULL; authoritative external provenance is in immutable admission receipt until explicit owner source adapter approved.

config.authority: Configuration stream owner proposed only; current effective config port publication/bootstrap OPEN. Disabled/missing source fails, no company/legal defaults.
